title: Technical Analysis (light contract)
description: Written by the technical agent (Phase 2), independently of fundamentals. Indicator math via a cited runtime script; levels are judgment with rationale.

compute_script.description: Path to runtime script under data/compute/.

benchmarks.description: Regional benchmark + sector index/ETF, chosen per market.

indicators.description: Computed values: trend, momentum, volatility (ATR), volume, relative strength.

side.description: pass = no trade. entry/stop required only when side is long or short (machine on harness >= 2.10.0).

levels.description: Entry/stop/targets required for long/short setups. Omit or empty when side=pass.

position_sizing.description: Volatility/ATR-based sizing with rationale. Not a duration-book size.
